{{Top|leg}}
'''Baatar''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] within the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] military structure known as the [[Kolkpravis]]. A Baatar lead a [[Brigade (Kolkpravis)|brigade]] which consisted of one hundred to two hundred hordes each lead by a [[Tarkhan]] and made up of one hundred [[kamen]] each led by a [[Blackarm]]. Several Baatars answered to each of the eight [[Khan/Legends|Khans]] in the [[Izvoshra/Legends|Izvoshra]] as part of their [[khanate]].<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
